newsitem.title: LATVIA: ROJA SAYS Q1 FIGURES "LOWER THAN 1996".
newsitem.headline: ROJA SAYS Q1 FIGURES "LOWER THAN 1996".

text.p: Roja fish cannery said on Friday that its first quarter results were lower than the same period of 1995 but declined to give any figures.

"This year's first quarter figures are not so good as last year since our production costs have increased and prices on our main markets have gone down," Valdis Simsons, deputy chairman of the board, told Reuters.
"Supply on the Russian and Ukrainian markets has reached a higher level of saturation," Simsons said.
The company said that its 1996 profit figures were better than in 1995 without giving details.
"Everything that we earned last year is being invested, besides a credit that we have taken," Simsons said.
Roja's assets rose by 20 percent during last year compared to 1995.
The company, which began operations as a public company in the last quarter of 1996, said it was now investing heavily.
"We are leasing one of our three ships and have repaired and installed new machinery on two others, owned by our partners," Simsons said.
Roja expects to increase its tinned fish production capacity by half from 1.4 million tins a year, when a new facility comes fully operational in spring.
"We plan to launch a full operation of our new tinned sprat facility in May, June," Simsons said.
"We have entered a joint venture with the municipality to operate water purification facilities and improve them," Simsosns said.
"This is a project with partial financing from the Danish and Latvian governments," he added.
